normalized.result: That does just what I'd want. I opened More actions on the customer-interviews bookmark, chose Delete permanently, confirmed, and it vanished from the library entirely with the count dropping to match — and no Undo offered, which is right for a permanent delete since I already confirmed it by name. That keeps the real difference clear: archive sets things aside and can be undone, delete is final. This is exactly the two-way distinction I wanted.
